HWSTRB_width.note: Only present if Write_Strobes property is True (Issue C)

HRESETn_WIDTH.note: active LOW (only active-LOW signal in AHB)

PRDATA_WIDTH.note: Must match PWDATA_WIDTH on the interface

ahb_protection_HPROT_extended_7bit.HPROT[6]: Shareable (1=Shareable, 0=Non-shareable; must be 0 for Device memory)

ahb_burst_address_rules.WRAP4_example_word: 4-beat wrapping burst of word (4-byte) accesses wraps at 16-byte boundaries (4 * 4 = 16). Address 0x34 next 0x38, 0x3C, then wraps to 0x30.
ahb_burst_address_rules.WRAP8_example_word: 8-beat wrapping burst of word accesses wraps at 32-byte boundaries (8 * 4 = 32).
ahb_burst_address_rules.INCR_1kb_boundary_rule: Managers must not attempt to start an incrementing burst that crosses a 1KB address boundary.
ahb_burst_address_rules.burst_alignment_rule: All transfers in a burst must be aligned to the address boundary equal to the size of the transfer (HADDR[log2(2^HSIZE)-1:0] = 0).

apb_byte_lane_mapping_PSTRB.PSTRB_per_byte: There is one write strobe per 8 bits of write data; PSTRB[n] corresponds to PWDATA[(8n+7):8n].
apb_byte_lane_mapping_PSTRB.PSTRB_read_rule: For read transfers, the master must drive all bits of PSTRB LOW.

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.ahb_lock_rule: all locked transfers must be in same Subordinate region

default_signal_values_when_omitted_ahb.HPROT: 0b0011 (Non-cacheable, Non-bufferable, Privileged, Data access) when omitted

PPROT[0] 1 = privileged access / 0 = normal access; PPROT[1] 1 = nonsecure access / 0 = secure access; PPROT[2] 1 = instruction access / 0 = data access.
